verdict.rationale: Claude's Research feature runs agentic, multi-step searches and returns answers "complete with easy-to-check citations" (claude-docs-20, -27, -39, -68). One community user says it "works pretty nicely for research" (claude-comm-9), while another finds ChatGPT and Gemini deeper on generic research (claude-comm-8); that is a quality complaint, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that searches hit the live/current web (the docs say only "searches"), detail on how citations link back to sources, and independent hands-on confirmation of citation accuracy.
